title: Microsoft 365 admin center: rules that automate agent lifecycle management
summary: The briefing is supported by current Microsoft documentation, including the premium Agent 365 licensing requirement. The user-access API row needs a preview warning and the request settings that make it apply access changes rather than merely monitor them.
